x.title: x
x.description: The initial `x` position of the player.

z.title: z
z.description: The initial `z` position of the player.

spreaddistance.title: spreadDistance
spreaddistance.description: The distance between players when they spawn. Default: `0.0`.

maxrange.title: maxRange
maxrange.description: The furthest distance that players can spawn from each other. Default: `0.0`.

victim.title: victim
victim.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

maxheight.title: maxHeight
maxheight.description: The maximum height that players can spawn. Default: `0.0`.
